title: Floating Robotics AG - RobotToday
content: Floating Robotics AG was a Swiss agricultural robotics startup headquartered in Schlieren, canton of Zurich, Switzerland. The company was a spin-off from the Robotic Systems Lab (RSL) at ETH Zurich and focused on developing cable-driven robotic systems for greenhouse automation tasks such as harvesting and de-leafing.
